column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./engine/ -run TestAdminReReplay_RefusesAfterTheRetentionSweepHasSweptAPendingCall -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two. Guards cleat#2038: history_swept_at is set by DeleteExpiredEvents on all three dialects, so ReReplay's guard can tell "swept" from "never attempted" -- the marking UPDATE is a separately written statement per dialect (engine/db.go, engine/mysql_ops.go, engine/mssql_schedules.go), and a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two.
